paragraphs: R. Nehorai [נהוריי]: Elijah asked him why earthquakes occur and why creeping creatures were created, Jerusalem Talmud, HaRo'eh, mishnah 3. R. Simon in R. Yose's name, in Nehorai's name, Jerusalem Talmud, Yevamot 1, halakhah 6. See above, R. Nehorai whom Elijah asked; certainly one person. [The identification is the source narrator's.]
